task: Design a VHH nanobody against Epstein-Barr virus BHRF1 that targets the accessible BH3-binding cleft and is intended to inhibit pro-survival ligand engagement.
Design a VHH nanobody against the human PD-L1 extracellular domain that is intended to inhibit PD-1 engagement.
Design a VHH nanobody binder against the de novo beta-barrel protein BBF-14 using an accessible, structurally coherent surface epitope.
Design a VHH nanobody binder against maltose-binding protein using an accessible, structurally coherent epitope.
Design a VHH nanobody against the human IL-7 receptor alpha extracellular domain that is intended to inhibit IL-7 receptor engagement.
Design a VHH nanobody against the human EGFR ectodomain that is intended to inhibit ligand-driven receptor activation.
Design an inhibitory VHH nanobody against Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9 using an accessible, functionally relevant surface site.
